// Ninja Log — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/dungeon-templates.js

// Re-run tools/safe-edit/bin/_build-dungeon-animations.js to regenerate.

(async () => {

const CFG = {"totalTimeoutMs":20000,"t":{"swap":70,"pop":360,"drop":380,"bounce":240,"lie":400,"logGone":90,"vanishHold":340,"returnPause":300,"reveal":70},"k":{"logSize":0.6,"popH":0.55,"drift":0.26,"swapPuff":1.39,"vanishPuff":1.31,"backPuff":1.11},"sfx":[{"at":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Shukuchi.wav","v":0.6},{"at":810,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Klonoa/wood_pop_a.wav","v":0.55},{"at":1450,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/SmokeBomb.wav","v":0.55}]};

const ASSETS = {"clips":{"poof":{"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Animation/Guilty%20Gear%20Strive/webm/smoke_anim08.webm","w":256,"h":256,"dur":800,"ax":0.5,"ay":0.5,"mask":true}},"images":{"log":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Item%20Icon/Log.png"}};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.dungeon.party.ninja-log";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Ninja Log]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// ── Party kit (prepended to every party shot by party-signatures.js) ─────────

// Ports of the approved "Party Action Animations" mockup helpers onto

// oni.timeline. Mockup px were drawn for a ~300 px tall battler, so every size

// and distance below is multiplied by U = caster height / 300.

// Storage rules: no backticks and no dollar-brace anywhere in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && t.center && (!caster || t.id !== caster.id));

// boot(extra): the timeline with the caster as 'c', targets as t0..tn, plus extra tokens.

// poses (optional): oni.timeline spec.poses, e.g. { c: { dl: { prop: 'sprite_standard' } } }.

async function boot(extra, poses) {

const tokens = {};

if (caster) tokens.c = cfg.foot ? { token: caster, foot: cfg.foot } : { token: caster };

const TG = [];

targets.forEach((t, i) => { const k = 't' + i; TG.push(k); tokens[k] = cfg.targetFoot ? { token: t, foot: cfg.targetFoot } : { token: t }; });

Object.assign(tokens, extra || {});

// live: the party shots never move the camera, so they run on the LIVE board (oni-timeline

// spec.live): idle bounce, depth, 3D parallax keep running; only touched tokens are taken over.

// depthRef: clip sizes are authored for the caster; on a 3D / depth-map stage the engine

// rescales a clip placed on another battler (or on the floor) by the depth ratio to it.

const tl = oni.timeline({ tokens, clips: A.clips || {}, images: A.images || {}, poses: poses || {}, live: cfg.live !== false, depthRef: caster ? 'c' : null });

await tl.load();

const T = []; const m = tl.mk(T);

const TOK = tl.TOK;

const U = ((TOK.c && TOK.c.h) || 300) / 300;

K._tl = tl; K._c0 = TOK.c ? tl.feet(TOK.c) : null;

return { tl, T, m, TOK, TG, U, E: tl.E };

}

const K = {};

K.ready = () => { const h = ctx.params.readyHook; if (h) { try { Hooks.callAll(h); } catch (e) {} } };

K.dirOf = (TOK, k) => (TOK[k] && TOK[k].dir) || -1;

K.feet = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; return tl.feet(t); };

K.mid = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.5 }; };

K.head = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); return { x: f.x, y: f.y - t.h * 0.92 }; };

// BD places a summon at caster_front: caster centre +/- max(1.15 cell, meshW/2 + 0.65 cell) toward stage centre.

K.summonSpot = (tl, k) => { const t = tl.TOK[k]; const f = tl.feet(t); const g = tl.GRID; const sx = (tl.REST.cx < f.x) ? -1 : 1; return { x: f.x + sx * Math.max(1.15 * g, t.w / 2 + 0.65 * g), y: f.y }; };

// CSS-filter tint for white GG mask clips (the mockup recipe: sepia gives ~38deg, then rotate).

K.tintF = (hue, sat, br) => 'sepia(1) saturate(' + (sat || 5) + ') hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 38) + 'deg) brightness(' + (br || 1.1) + ')';

// Depth size of a body (phantasm skin, painted copy) whose feet are at p, relative to the

// caster where it stands (1 on a flat stage). Set by boot() once the timeline exists.

K.depth = (p) => (K._tl && K._tl.depthRatio && K._c0) ? K._tl.depthRatio(K._c0, p) : 1;

K.ease = (E, name) => (name && E[name]) || E.ioQ;

// A token path: keys = [[t, dx, dy, ease?], ...]; held between keys, nothing before/after.

K.path = (m, E, k, keys) => {

const t0 = keys[0][0], t1 = keys[keys.length - 1][0];

m.hold(t0, t1 + 1, (tl, S) => {

const t = tl + t0; const q = S.tok[k]; if (!q) return;

for (let i = 1; i < keys.length; i++) {

const a = keys[i - 1], b = keys[i];

if (t <= b[0]) { const u = (b[0] === a[0]) ? 1 : K.ease(E, b[3])(Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (t - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0])))); q.dx += a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u; q.dy += a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u; return; }

}

});

};

// Step out toward the enemy and back. dist in mockup px.

K.step = (m, E, U, dir, k, out, hold, back, dist) => K.path(m, E, k, [[out, 0, 0], [out + 380, dir * dist * U, 0, 'ioQ'], [back, dir * dist * U, 0], [back + 460, 0, 0, 'ioQ']]);

// RO hexagram cast circle under k's feet. Eases in (scale .55 to 1 + fade, 380 ms),

// loops while channelling, fades out (420 ms) when released. Ground layer (z 2).

K.circle = (tl, m, U, k, at, hold, hue, o) => {

o = o || {}; const f0 = tl.feet(tl.TOK[k]); const f = { x: f0.x + (o.dx || 0), y: f0.y }; const s = (o.scale || 1) * Math.max(0.8, tl.TOK[k].w / (170 * U)) * U;

const dur = hold + 420; const w = 112 * 1.9 * 0.85 * 2.0 * s;

const shift = 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 268) + 'deg) brightness(1.35)';

const alpha = (u) => { const t = u * dur; return t < 380 ? t / 380 : t > hold ? Math.max(0, 1 - (t - hold) / 420) : 1; };

const live = (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: w * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : t > hold ? 1 + 0.08 * (t - hold) / 420 : 1) });

m.clip('mc', at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: shift, alpha, live });

if (o.ring) {

const rw = (A.clips[o.ring] ? A.clips[o.ring].w : 592) * 1.9 * 0.85 * 0.95 * s;

m.clip(o.ring, at, { x: f.x, y: f.y, w: rw, z: 2, add: true, loop: true, hold: dur, filter: 'hue-rotate(' + Math.round(hue - 265) + 'deg) brightness(1.1)', alpha, live: (t) => ({ x: f.x, y: f.y + 4 * U, w: rw * (t < 380 ? 0.55 + 0.45 * tl.E.outQ(t / 380) : 1) }) });

}

// the caster's glow while channelling

m.tint(at, hold, k, 'hsl(' + hue + ',90%,70%)', (u) => 0.35 * Math.sin(Math.PI * u));

};

// Wisp (port of battle-director/particles/wisps.js draw) on a travel path:

// lift lift px off from, then home along an arc to to. Trail = the path sampled into the past.

K.wisp = (m, at, from, to, o) => {

o = o || {}; const U = o.U || 1; const rgb = o.rgb || '110,180,255'; const rad = (o.rad || 7) * U;

const liftMs = o.liftMs || 380, travelMs = o.travelMs || 900, lift = (o.lift || 46) * U, arcH = (o.arcH || 120) * U;

const ph = o.phase != null ? o.phase : Math.random() * 6.28, sw = (o.sway || 16) * U;

const pos = (e) => {

const up = { x: from.x + Math.sin(ph) * 18 * U, y: from.y - lift };

if (e < liftMs) { const k = 1 - (1 - e / liftMs) * (1 - e / liftMs); return { x: from.x + (up.x - from.x) * k, y: from.y + (up.y - from.y) * k }; }

const k = Math.min(1, (e - liftMs) / travelMs), q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2;

return { x: up.x + (to.x - up.x) * q + Math.sin(k * 9 + ph) * sw * (1 - k), y: up.y + (to.y - up.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * arcH };

};

const end = liftMs + travelMs;

m.hold(at, at + end, (e, S) => {

S.world.push({ z: 60, draw: (g) => {

const a = Math.min(1, e / 180); const p = pos(e);

g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.lineCap = 'round';

const n = 20; let prev = null;

for (let i = n; i >= 0; i--) { const q = pos(Math.max(0, e - i * 16)); if (prev) { const f = 1 - i / n; g.strokeStyle = 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.42 * f * a).toFixed(3) + ')'; g.lineWidth = rad * 2.4 * f; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y); g.lineTo(q.x, q.y); g.stroke(); } prev = q; }

const hr = rad * 7; let gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, hr);

gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.5 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',' + (0.16 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, hr, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

const tw = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(e * 0.013 + ph), L = rad * 7.5 * tw;

g.save(); g.translate(p.x, p.y); g.rotate(ph + e * 0.002);

for (let q2 = 0; q2 < 4; q2++) { const len = q2 < 2 ? L : L * 0.5; g.save(); g.rotate(q2 * Math.PI / 2 + (q2 >= 2 ? Math.PI / 4 : 0)); const lg = g.createLinearGradient(-len, 0, len, 0); lg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); lg.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + ((q2 < 2 ? 0.85 : 0.45) * a * tw).toFixed(3) + ')'); lg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)'); g.strokeStyle = lg; g.lineWidth = 1.4 * U; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(-len, 0); g.lineTo(len, 0); g.stroke(); g.restore(); }

g.restore();

gr = g.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9); gr.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + a.toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.7 * a).toFixed(3) + ')'); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(' + rgb + ',0)');

g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(p.x, p.y, rad * 1.9, 0, 6.283); g.fill();

g.restore();

} });

});

return at + end;

};

// Glass shards (or embers) flung from pt; deterministic per seed.

K.shards = (tl, m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = tl.rng(seed || 7); const P2 = [];

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) P2.push({ a: r() * 6.283, d: spread * U * (0.5 + r() * 0.6), r0: r() * 6.28, rs: (r() - 0.5) * 16, ms: 700 + r() * 300 });

m.hold(at, at + 1000, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 62, draw: (g) => {

for (const s of P2) { const u = Math.min(1, e / s.ms); if (u >= 1) continue; const k = 1 - (1 - u) * (1 - u);

g.save(); g.translate(pt.x + Math.cos(s.a) * s.d * k, pt.y + Math.sin(s.a) * s.d * k + 90 * U * u * u); g.rotate(s.r0 + s.rs * u); g.scale(1 - 0.5 * u, 1 - 0.5 * u);

g.globalAlpha = 1 - u; g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; const gr = g.createLinearGradient(-8 * U, -11 * U, 8 * U, 11 * U); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(1, color); g.fillStyle = gr;

g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(0, -11 * U); g.lineTo(8 * U, -2 * U); g.lineTo(3 * U, 11 * U); g.lineTo(-8 * U, 4 * U); g.closePath(); g.fill(); g.restore(); }

} }));

};

// A soft glowing orb travelling an arc (from, to) over ms.

K.orb = (m, at, from, to, ms, h, color, size, U) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => { const k = e / ms, q = k < 0.5 ? 2 * k * k : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * k + 2, 2) / 2; const x = from.x + (to.x - from.x) * q, y = from.y + (to.y - from.y) * q - Math.sin(k * Math.PI) * h * U;

S.world.push({ z: 61, draw: (g) => { const r = size * U; const gr = g.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, r); gr.addColorStop(0, '#fff'); gr.addColorStop(0.35, color); gr.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)'); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = gr; g.beginPath(); g.arc(x, y, r, 0, 6.283); g.fill(); g.restore(); } }); });

};

// GG twinkle sparks around pt (mask clip, tinted).

K.twinkles = (m, at, pt, color, n, spread, U, seed) => {

const r = Math.random; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) m.clip('twinkle', at + i * 70, { x: pt.x + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, y: pt.y + (r() - 0.5) * spread * 2 * U, w: 64 * 1.6 * 0.85 * U, z: 63, add: true, filter: color });

};

// ── Phantasm skins: draw(g, x, feetY, alpha, scale, t) at a feet point. ──

// mirage = Illusionist default: a violet double of the CASTER (red/cyan split, flicker).

// foxfire = Keren: her Fox fire summon art (A.images.foxfire), a pink spirit flame.

K.skin = (tl, name, U) => {

if (name === 'foxfire') {

const img = tl.IMG.foxfire; const size = 120 * U;

return { h: size + 40 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!img || a <= 0) return; const iw = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 1, ih = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 1; const h = size * (s || 1), w = h * iw / ih; const fl = 1 + 0.06 * Math.sin(t / 60);

g.save(); g.translate(x, y - 40 * U); g.scale(1 / fl, fl); g.globalAlpha = a; g.shadowColor = '#ff6fb4'; g.shadowBlur = 18 * U; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.globalAlpha = a * 0.35; g.drawImage(img, -w / 2, -h, w, h); g.restore(); } };

}

const art = tl.art('c'); const T0 = tl.TOK.c;

return { h: T0 ? T0.h : 300 * U, draw(g, x, y, a, s, t) { if (!art || !T0 || a <= 0) return; const w = T0.w * (s || 1), h = T0.h * (s || 1); const j = (Math.floor(t / 70) % 12 === 0) ? 9 * U : 4 * U;

const one = (f, al, ox, add) => { g.save(); g.translate(x + ox, y); g.scale(T0.flip, 1); g.globalAlpha = al; g.filter = f; if (add) g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.drawImage(art, -w / 2, -h * T0.foot, w, h); g.restore(); };

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(4) hue-rotate(225deg) brightness(1.35) drop-shadow(0 0 8px #b98cff)', a * (0.72 + 0.08 * Math.sin(t / 70)), 0, false);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(-50deg)', a * 0.32, -j, true);

one('grayscale(1) sepia(1) saturate(8) hue-rotate(140deg)', a * 0.32, j, true); } };

};

// Draw a phantasm along posFn(e) -> { x, y (feet), a, s } between t0 and t1, with afterimages when moving.

K.phantasm = (m, skin, t0, t1, posFn, trail) => {

m.hold(t0, t1, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 30, draw: (g) => {

if (trail) for (let i = 4; i >= 1; i--) { const q = posFn(Math.max(0, e - i * 60)); const p0 = posFn(e); if (Math.hypot(q.x - p0.x, q.y - p0.y) < 4) continue; g.save(); g.filter = 'blur(2px)'; skin.draw(g, q.x, q.y, (q.a || 1) * 0.3 * (1 - i / 5), (q.s || 1) * K.depth(q), e); g.restore(); }

const p = posFn(e); skin.draw(g, p.x, p.y, p.a == null ? 1 : p.a, (p.s || 1) * K.depth(p), e);

} }));

};

// ── 8-direction spin (the walk-map standing art) ──

// The five drawn standing slots, all drawn facing LEFT; the three right-hand views are mirrors.

K.SPIN8_POSES = { dl: { prop: 'sprite_standard' }, d: { prop: 'sprite_stand_down' }, l: { prop: 'sprite_stand_left' }, ul: { prop: 'sprite_stand_up_left' }, u: { prop: 'sprite_stand_up' } };

// Opaque rows of an image (alpha > 128) as fractions of its height, or null (unreadable).

K.bodyBox = (img) => {

try {

const W = img.naturalWidth || img.videoWidth || img.width, H = img.naturalHeight || img.videoHeight || img.height; if (!W || !H) return null;

const cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = W; cv.height = H; const x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);

const d = x.getImageData(0, 0, W, H).data; let top = -1, bot = -1;

for (let y = 0; y < H && top < 0; y++) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) if (d[(y * W + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) { top = y; break; }

for (let y = H - 1; y >= 0 && bot < 0; y--) for (let i = 0; i < W; i++) if (d[(y * W + i) * 4 + 3] > 128) { bot = y + 1; break; }

return top < 0 ? null : { top: top / H, bot: bot / H };

} catch (e) { return null; }

};

// After boot(_, { k: K.SPIN8_POSES }): true when all five slots loaded for token k. Re-sizes

// every slot by ONE scale (the standing body height matched to the battle art's body height)

// and gives each slot its own feet line, so no frame jumps against another.

K.spin8Ready = (tl, k) => {

const P = tl.POSE[k]; if (!P) return false;

for (const s of ['dl', 'd', 'l', 'ul', 'u']) if (!P[s] || !P[s].img) return false;

const T = tl.TOK[k], art = tl.art(k);

const ab = art ? K.bodyBox(art) : null, sb = K.bodyBox(P.dl.img);

const sH = P.dl.img.naturalHeight || P.dl.img.height;

let scale = P.dl.w / (P.dl.img.naturalWidth || P.dl.img.width);

if (ab && sb && sb.bot > sb.top) scale = (T.h * (ab.bot - ab.top)) / (sH * (sb.bot - sb.top));

for (const s in P) { const p = P[s]; const iw = p.img.naturalWidth || p.img.width, ih = p.img.naturalHeight || p.img.height; const b = K.bodyBox(p.img); p.w = iw * scale; p.h = ih * scale; if (b) p.foot = b.bot; }

return true;

};

// Slot for spin progress u (0..1, one full turn), for a body facing screen dir (-1 left).

// Turn order seen facing left: DL, D, DR, R, UR, U, UL, L (then back to DL).

// Returns { pose, sx } where sx multiplies the token's sx (mirror on screen when needed).

K.SPIN8_SEQ = [['dl', -1], ['d', 0], ['dl', 1], ['l', 1], ['ul', 1], ['u', 0], ['ul', -1], ['l', -1]];

K.spin8At = (T, dir, u) => {

const i = ((Math.floor(u * 8 + 0.5) % 8) + 8) % 8; const sl = K.SPIN8_SEQ[i];

const f = sl[1] * (dir < 0 ? 1 : -1); // screen facing wanted: -1 left, 1 right, 0 straight

// art faces left when T.flip * sx > 0; straight-on art is never mirrored

return { pose: sl[0], sx: f === 0 ? T.flip : -f * T.flip };

};

// Ring under a point on the ground (z 2), expanding; used as an arrival / selection mark.

K.groundRing = (m, at, ms, pt, r0, r1, color, U, dashed) => {

m.hold(at, at + ms, (e, S) => S.world.push({ z: 2, draw: (g) => { const u = e / ms; const r = (r0 + (r1 - r0) * (dashed ? 1 : u)) * U; g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.strokeStyle = color; g.lineWidth = 4 * U; g.globalAlpha = dashed ? 0.9 : 1 - u; if (dashed) { g.setLineDash([10 * U, 8 * U]); g.lineDashOffset = -e / 20; } g.beginPath(); g.ellipse(pt.x, pt.y, r, r * 0.37, 0, 0, 6.283); g.stroke(); g.restore(); } }));

};

// ── shot ──

// Ninja Log — approved mockup (round 3, 2026-11-06): the substitution trick on a BLOCK.

// Plays when a hit is soaked to 0 by Ninja Log (director-vfx playBlockVfx, which already

// floats BLOCK + plays the Parry block sound), on whoever wears it. Simple level: no

// cut-in, no dim, no camera. Every sound plays once (Parry is BD's, not ours).

// 0 GG smoke_anim08 puff over the wearer (first puff only, 0.7x) + Shukuchi

// 70 the wearer is gone; the item's own sprite (Log.png, never rotated) stands in

// his place, pops up and drops to the floor like a video-game item drop

// land one small bounce + the wood thud

// vanish a second GG puff swallows the log + Smoke Bomb

// back a silent GG puff on the wearer's spot; he is back, with a short white flash

if (!caster) { K.ready(); oni.fireDone(); return; }

const B = await boot(); const { tl, T, m, TOK, E } = B;

const t = cfg.t; const k = cfg.k;

const C = TOK.c; const cf = K.feet(tl, 'c'); const cm = K.mid(tl, 'c');

const dir = K.dirOf(TOK, 'c');

const H = C.h;

const img = tl.IMG.log;

const LB = H * k.logSize; // the log sprite's square box

const rest = cf.y - LB / 2; // centre when its box sits on the floor

const top = cm.y - H * k.popH;

const drift = dir * H * k.drift;

const land = t.swap + t.pop + t.drop;

const vanish = land + t.bounce + t.lie;

const back = vanish + t.vanishHold + t.returnPause;

// GG smoke_anim08 holds two puffs back to back: show only the first, slowed to 0.7x.

const PUFF = Math.round(380 / 0.7);

function puff(at, p, w) {

const cl = m.clip('poof', at, { x: p.x, y: p.y, w, z: 60, hold: PUFF, depth: false, filter: 'drop-shadow(0 3px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.25))', alpha: (u) => (u > 0.7 ? Math.max(0, (1 - u) / 0.3) : 1) });

m.hold(at, at + PUFF, () => { const v = cl && cl.copy && cl.copy.video; if (v && v.playbackRate !== 0.7) v.playbackRate = 0.7; });

}

// the wearer is hidden from the swap until his return

m.hold(t.swap, back + t.reveal, (e, S) => { if (S.tok.c) S.tok.c.hidden = true; });

puff(0, { x: cm.x, y: cm.y + H * 0.05 }, H * k.swapPuff);

// the log: centre position over time (static sprite)

const logAt = (at) => {

if (at < t.pop) { const u = E.outQ(at / t.pop); return { x: cf.x + drift * 0.45 * u, y: cm.y + (top - cm.y) * u }; }

const a2 = at - t.pop;

if (a2 < t.drop) { const u = E.inQ(a2 / t.drop); return { x: cf.x + drift * (0.45 + 0.45 * u), y: top + (rest - top) * u }; }

const a3 = a2 - t.drop;

if (a3 < t.bounce) { const u = a3 / t.bounce; return { x: cf.x + drift * (0.9 + 0.1 * u), y: rest - Math.sin(u * Math.PI) * H * k.popH * 0.18 }; }

return { x: cf.x + drift, y: rest };

};

m.hold(t.swap, vanish + t.logGone, (e, S) => {

if (!img) return; const p = logAt(e);

S.world.push({ z: 20, draw: (g) => { g.save(); g.imageSmoothingEnabled = false; g.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 4px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.35))'; g.drawImage(img, p.x - LB / 2, p.y - LB / 2, LB, LB); g.restore(); } });

});

// the vanish puff on the fallen log

const lp = logAt(1e9);

puff(vanish, { x: lp.x, y: lp.y - LB * 0.1 }, H * k.vanishPuff);

// back on his spot: a silent puff, then he reappears with a short white flash

puff(back, cm, H * k.backPuff);

m.tint(back + t.reveal, 320, 'c', '#ffffff', (u) => 0.55 * (1 - u));

await tl.run(T, { total: back + PUFF + 500, sfx: cfg.sfx || [], onStart: K.ready });

oni.fireDone();

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS, strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Ninja Log" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:carrierAnimationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:carrierAnimationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();
